name: CSB Bank Ltd
title: CSB Bank Ltd - 542867 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 profit up 32% QoQ to Rs202cr with GNPA 1.66%, but NIM fell 2-3bps QoQ, CTI guided 60-65% through FY27, and retail asset growth pushed to FY28.

triggers.label: NIM down 2-3bps QoQ
triggers.quote: the NIM has fallen by two or three basis points over Q3

triggers.label: Wholesale deposits ~50% of term deposits
triggers.quote: yes - it is around 50% of our overall term deposits

triggers.label: CTI 60-65% through FY27
triggers.quote: On the CTI, I would always say that we will be between 60% to 65% till end of FY2027

triggers.label: Retail asset growth deferred to FY28
triggers.quote: Our meaningful growth in retail assets will start from FY2028 onwards.

guidance.quote: it will remain in the range of 3.75% to 3.8%
I think 25% is something that we will strive for
Till FY27 end, our CTI will remain between 60% to 65%
a range of somewhere around 1.5% and 15% for ROA and ROE respectively will sustain
Our eventual play is to bring gold loan to 30% of our portfolio by 2030.

red_flags.label: Wholesale deposits ~50% of term deposits
red_flags.quote: yes - it is around 50% of our overall term deposits

red_flags.label: Gold loan share rising, retail assets degrowing
red_flags.quote: our retail assets growth this year has been negative primarily because of the loan against gold security

red_flags.label: Unrecognised AI cybersecurity compliance cost
red_flags.quote: Right now, we are doing what is stipulated in the April 27th advisory

evasions.quote: it is premature to answer on this one
It is not right from a customer perspective or from a disclosure perspective to go this granular
